title: Calloway Limited Home Warranty Billing Note: Reinspection Charge on a Re-Measured Crack
content:
**Clause.** A reinspection charge on a Calloway Limited Home Warranty coverage is worked out for the most recent inspection recorded on the coverage that found a crack within tolerance, on the day it is assessed, and it is linked to that inspection's claim item. The inspection a reinspection charge is worked out for counts as the re-measurement of a re-reported item only when the coverage records at least two claim items filed in that inspection's defect category and at least two denials for within tolerance, whichever claim items those denials concern; where either count falls short, the inspection counts as a first report and no reinspection charge is made. The visit charge of a re-measurement is the program's reinspection fee, and the reinspection charge is the visit charge, rounded to the nearest cent once, at the end.

The inspection's defect category is the category of its claim item as that item was filed.

## Re-measurement test

| Claim items filed on the coverage in the inspection's defect category | Denials for within tolerance on the coverage | The inspection counts as | Charge |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2 or more | 2 or more | Re-measurement of a re-reported item | The visit charge, rounded to the cent |
| 2 or more | 1 or none | First report | None |
| 1 | any | First report | None |

## Worked figures (hypothetical program reinspection fee USD 100.00)

1. Latest within-tolerance inspection on a concrete flatwork item; the coverage records three concrete flatwork items and two within-tolerance denials. Re-measurement; visit charge USD 100.00; reinspection charge USD 100.00.
2. Same, but only one within-tolerance denial is recorded. First report; no reinspection charge.
3. Two within-tolerance denials, but they concern drywall items while the latest within-tolerance inspection is on the only masonry veneer item filed. Only one item in that category: first report; no charge.
